site_description: An evidence-driven journey from customer data and LLM evaluation to bounded agents, production hardening, and FDE delivery.

phases.title: Problem and Data Foundations
phases.summary: Start with the workflow, then create synthetic evidence and a semantic layer that the AI system can trust.

phases.title: LLM Engineering
phases.summary: Cross from deterministic software into probabilistic behavior with structured outputs, frozen cases, and regression measurement.

phases.title: Retrieval and Grounding
phases.summary: Measure search quality before generation, then require policy claims to resolve to retrieved evidence.

phases.title: Tools and Agents
phases.summary: Treat tools as typed APIs, bound the model loop, preserve state, and separate recommendation from authority.

phases.title: Product and Operations
phases.summary: Expose capabilities safely, build the analyst workflow, observe individual runs, and design known failures.

phases.title: FDE Capstone
phases.summary: Turn technical experiments into a defensible customer, engineering, security, operations, and investment decision.

articles.summary: Why the first engineering decision is choosing a measurable customer workflow, not choosing an AI framework.
How structural truth, semantic truth, and scale evidence create a safe substrate for AI experiments.
Why deterministic customer metrics and time semantics must remain below the probabilistic model boundary.
A data engineer's first controlled transition from deterministic calculations to structured model behavior.
Freeze prompts and cases, compare per-case behavior, and refuse to hide regressions behind an average.
Compare lexical and vector retrieval using Recall@K, MRR, latency, and explicit relevance judgments.
Retrieval is necessary but insufficient: citations, excerpts, and unsupported policy claims need separate evaluation.
Use controlled retrieval experiments to improve the weakest boundary before changing the model.
Schemas, bounds, typed failures, and deterministic execution turn functions into trustworthy model tools.
Measure tool selection, arguments, evidence, stopping behavior, latency, and cost across the complete agent loop.
Make routing, checkpoints, recovery, and state transitions explicit without changing the accepted behavior.
A recommendation is not authorization: exact-payload review, audit, and idempotency protect consequential actions.
Compare runtimes against one frozen contract and choose from workflow fit rather than framework novelty.
Expose four bounded, read-only capabilities through an authenticated protocol instead of exposing a database.
Turn the backend into a coherent analyst workflow with search, investigation, evidence review, and approval.
Move from aggregate success to inspectable runs spanning tools, retrieval, tokens, cost, errors, and human evaluation.
Inject timeouts, dependency loss, malformed output, duplicates, loops, and capacity pressure before users do.
Connect customer discovery, architecture, controls, evidence, operations, economics, and the next reversible decision.
